items.question: Which plans are on sale?
items.answer: Pro one-time and Pro yearly, {percent}% off. Pro monthly and Team keep their prices.

items.question: Does Pro yearly renew at {yearly}?
items.answer: No. The sale covers the first year. After that the plan renews at {yearlyList} a year, unless you cancel it before then.

items.question: Didn't the prices just go up?
items.answer: Yes. Pro's prices changed on {listPriceSince}, and the sale takes {percent}% off those prices. Both sale prices are also below what Pro cost before that change. <prices>What changed and why</prices>.

items.question: I already pay for Pro monthly or yearly. Can I switch to one-time?
items.answer: Yes. Buy Pro one-time at the sale price, then cancel your subscription in the <portal>billing portal</portal> so it does not renew.

items.question: Do I need to type the code?
items.answer: Not when you buy from this site: checkout applies the discount for you. If you are asked for a code, it is {code}.

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: Yes, as with any purchase: within {refundDays} days. See the <refund>refund policy</refund>.
